info.description:

- Folder 2 CASE 1 fetches training types automatically then registers the trainer.
- Folder 7 CASE 1 re-registers the trainee automatically after deletion to restore state.
- Folder 4 CASE 1 changes trainee password and updates the variable — all subsequent requests use the new password.
